added_failures_note: The source manifest's completed baseline_suite names one failure, test_field_swap_record_reports_coverage_outcome, and its completed after_suite names no failures; set difference is empty.

assertion_audit.scripts/prototypes/efit_field_swap/test_: The fitted-mesh and JT-60SA outcome assertions fail if a wide wall has no contour vertex, the read stays unqualified, the index is wrong or any cell stays uncleared.
assertion_audit.scripts/prototypes/tcv_liuqe_known_answe: The cancelled-pair and occupied-cell assertions fail if equal boundary and admitted indices bypass the remaining cell enclosure; the old source produces unresolved 0, and line 162 fails.
The flat occupied and constant empty cell assertions fail if a zero gradient is treated as strictly signed or a depth cap silently clears it.
The invalid-axis refusal and valid limited-read assertions fail if an invalid axis is accepted or if a single true maximum is refused.
The annular-domain and loop-critical-point assertions fail if obstacle winding is added, a nonzero winding is missed or a zero on the loop is treated as reliable.

The real limited slice and synthetic outline assertions fail if a known limited read is refused, a 0.5 m outline span changes, the 0.1 m gap is scaled to anything but 0.2, or an absent X gap is invented.
The analytic field's winding-one checks and missed-saddle refusal fail if a missing saddle is admitted as limited or the boundary index ceases to be measured independently of the supplied census.

figure_review: Viewed all three final 1400-pixel PNG renderings; poloidal contours, wall loops, paired axes and boundary curves remain visible, with refusal panels labelled in the report captions.

findings.text: follow-on: The axis-to-outline span repeats the point-to-segment distance algorithm owned by nova/equilibrium/boundary_comparison.py:81; the addition duplicates that capability rather than extending or wrapping its owner.

follow-on: The LIUQE adapter hard-codes COCOS 17 and positive plasma current instead of using the equilibrium's own orientation, so a negative-current slice can be scored in the wrong flux polarity; the live plan already queues a polarity rescore.

follow-on: No added versioned assertion calls build or pins the per-slice absolute and relative maxima, so a regression can misattribute the report summary while the sixteen-test focused gate stays green; the one-off report change control does not provide durable coverage.
